contract: Road user a overtakes and passes road user b: travelling with headings aligned, a goes from wholly behind b to wholly ahead of it. The act is recognized at the observation at which a becomes wholly ahead of b, that is, at which drv.position.behind of b relative to a becomes true, provided that a was behind b (drv.position.behind of a relative to b) at an earlier observation and the headings stayed aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance) at every observation from that one to the recognition. Its observed beginning is the last observation at which a was behind b before the recognition. The concept holds at the recognition observation only. Where the recording shows no observation of a behind b before a becomes wholly ahead of it, with the headings aligned at every observation since the recording began, whether a overtook b is unknown, never false. Not a stand-in for a lane change or for contact between the bodies; it does not say in which lane either travels.

params.name: alignment
params.meaning: the cosine of the largest angle between the two headings counted as aligned

act.onset: Its observed beginning is the last observation at which a was behind b before the recognition.
act.recognition: The act is recognized at the observation at which a becomes wholly ahead of b
act.extent: The concept holds at the recognition observation only.
act.history: Where the recording shows no observation of a behind b before a becomes wholly ahead of it, with the headings aligned at every observation since the recording began, whether a overtook b is unknown, never false.

elements.span: drv.position.behind of b relative to a becomes true
elements.justification: drv.position.behind: 'their headings are aligned and b's body lies wholly ahead of a's along a's heading'; read with b as the one behind, it is a wholly ahead of b, and 'becomes true' is that state here and not at the observation before: the recognition.

elements.span: provided that a was behind b (drv.position.behind of a relative to b) at an earlier observation
elements.justification: drv.position.behind read with a as the one behind gives the beginning. 'At an earlier observation' is strict: the observation must precede the recognition, and a behind b at the recognition itself is no beginning. drv.position.behind measures 'wholly ahead of a's along a's heading', each road user along its own heading, so where the headings are aligned but not parallel and the bodies lie apart laterally, a can be behind b and b behind a at one observation; such an observation, the recognition, never witnesses its own beginning. Since b was not behind a at the observation before the recognition, the condition is the past condition (a behind b at some observation, headings aligned at every one after it) as it stood at that previous observation, with the headings also aligned at the recognition.

elements.span: the headings stayed aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance)
elements.justification: rel.same_direction: 'headings aligned: the cosine of the angle between the headings is above its tolerance'; held at every observation from the beginning to the recognition, both included, so an oncoming crossing is no pass, and an observation with the headings not aligned and no later observation of a behind b before the recognition leaves the act false, not unknown.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: a, in the left lane wholly behind b with aligned headings, comes alongside and becomes wholly ahead of b; the concept holds at that observation.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: At the first observation the headings are opposed. At the next, the headings are aligned but not parallel and the bodies lie apart laterally, so that each road user lies wholly ahead of the other along its own heading: b becomes behind a there while a is also behind b at that same observation, and a was behind b at no earlier observation. The headings were not aligned since the recording began, so the act did not occur; the concept is false at that observation.
